Stock market news | Sensex jumps over 2,000 points as Nifty hits 25,951

Indian stock markets saw a strong rally on 25 November 2026. The Sensex jumped over 2,000 points intraday, while the Nifty climbed 2.2% to reach 25,951. Foreign institutional investor inflows and declining crude oil prices helped boost market sentiment.
